implementation: Canonical optional Product.fulfillment; one formatter/helper; no stock/price/SKU changes.
Render notice above purchase buttons, shipping accordion, cart drawer/page lines, checkout order lines. Derive client notice by current catalog slug, not trusted persisted client text.
For any cart containing extended preparation, use canonical server notices in Stripe product description/custom_text and omit unsupported total delivery_estimate while preserving charges/services.
Snapshot server-resolved per-line preparation notice in existing journey JSON and Stripe product metadata for durable order confirmation.
Conditionally suppress hardcoded JSON-LD deliveryTime for these products until appropriate handling-day semantics are established; never emit default1–3 for them.
Confirmation renders saved preparation notices and labels existing market window as transit after dispatch. No email sent during validation.
Audit merchant output handling promises separately; never manufacture availability_date or mark0stock to express production delay.
